items.title: 61124_Mario Bauza oral history interview
items.q: Another Panamanian piano player that came later was Rivera.

ctx.x: But what happened with Rodriguez? He played with Benny Carter for awhile, right?

Yeah, and after that he'd go for the small group, and -- or lounge work, and maybe he'd go (unintelligible), but it never materialized to nothing. Another Panamanian piano player that came later was Rivera.
